caption: People covered in tomato pulp and juice throw tomatoes at one another.
Barcelona, Spain A wildfire in the Collserola mountain range sends smoke over the Nou Barris district, forcing some residents to evacuate.
Trishuli Bazar, Nepal Houses in the Nuwakot district are partly submerged in mud after flash floods along a riverside.
Pomas, France A tornado damaged about 300 homes in the south-western Occitania region.
New York, US The Empire State Building was lit up in pink at 9.25pm on Tuesday night to celebrate the life of Dolly Parton, in a nod to her film 9 to 5.
Kaili, China People burn paper offerings in tribute to their departed loved ones before the Zhongyuan festival, also known as the Ghost festival.
Reading, UK Visitors arrive with backpacks for the start of Reading festival.
Buñol, Spain Revellers lie in tomatoes during the annual La Tomatina fiesta in a village near València.
Kolkata, India People queue to collect food distributed on the anniversary of Mother Teresa’s birth.
Playas de Tijuana, Mexico A dead whale stranded on the beach in Baja California state.
Kalochori, Greece The bed of the Kalochori lagoon, a key wetland for migratory birds, has dried up due to lack of rainfall and extreme heat.
Kharkiv, Ukraine A man comforts an elderly woman whose house sustained serious damage from a Russian drone strike.
Khan Younis, Gaza Strip Two girls walk past the rubble of collapsed buildings.
Tyre, Lebanon Smoke rises from the site of a string of Israeli airstrikes targeting the al-Mansouri area.
A performer, with long dark hair and makeup, sits behind a glowing white orb with her hands raised. Other performers, women in black costume with feathered headwear, sit around her.

Patna, India Police use water cannon to disperse students during a protest demanding the cancellation of a civil service recruitment exam over allegations of question paper leaks and other irregularities.
Reno, US A melted playground slide as the Hawk fire burns in Nevada.

Semur-en-Auxois, France President Emmanuel Macron during the funeral of the French senator and former minister François Patriat. The former Socialist was the group leader of Macron’s party in the Senate. He died aged 83 after a cycling accident.

Middlesbrough, UK A model police car among floral tributes to two officers killed after a car driving the wrong way on a dual carriageway crashed into their vehicle. The five occupants of the other vehicle also died.

Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh Rohingya refugees take part in the ‘Genocide Remembrance Day’ rally to mark the ninth anniversary of their mass exodus from Myanmar following a military crackdown. Tens of thousands of Rohingya refugees protested against dire conditions in Bangladesh’s sprawling camps.
Pomas, France A man walks past damaged houses and cars a day after a tornado struck the village near Carcassonne in southern France.

Khan Younis, Gaza Strip A person holds a photo of Mariam Dagga as journalists and family members gather to mark the first anniversary of the killing of Dagga and Hussam al-Masri, two journalists who were among those killed in an Israeli strike on Nasser hospital.

Athy, Ireland The cortege for Jack Kennedy makes its way through the town in County Kildare before his funeral at St Michael’s parish church. The 17-year-old was one of five teenagers who died in a head-on collision on a motorway earlier this month.
Jerusalem Muslim worshippers walk past a songbird cage as they gather for Mawlid al-Nabi celebrations, the birth anniversary of the prophet Muhammad, in the Old City.
Tokyo, Japan People use parasols to shield themselves from the scorching sun.

London, UK Striking drivers from the Unite trade union on the picket line at the Stamford Hill bus garage. Arriva North London bus drivers are striking over dangerous working conditions, as in-cab temperatures during summer heatwaves have exceeded 40C due to inadequate air-cooling systems.

Washington DC, US A glowing ‘jellyfish’ effect from a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket in the early morning sky. The phenomenon occurs when sunlight illuminates the rocket’s expanding exhaust plume at high altitude while the sky below remains dark.
Athens, Greece People read books in the shade at the National Garden.

Edinburgh, UK The company of Verdi’s A Masked Ball during rehearsals at the Festival theatre as part of the Edinburgh international festival. The Zurich Opera House production relocates the original opera from Sweden to the opulent Gilded Age of the US.
Beijing, China A humanoid robot after competing in the breakdance at the World Humanoid Robot Games.
Oleksii Kozak is helped out of the water during a sporting event in Kyiv.

Middlesbrough, UK A police officer leaves flowers for PC Matthew Blades and PC Tom Clough at the Cleveland police HQ memorial garden. The pair were killed when a vehicle being pursued by police was driven the wrong way along a dual carriageway and collided with their marked armed response vehicle.

Tokyo, Japan People walk past a cooling mist station during a heatwave. Temperatures have reached 39C (102.2F) in parts of the country, prompting the national meteorological agency to issue heatstroke alerts in dozens of prefectures.

Kyiv, Ukraine Andy Burnham meets people injured in Russia’s war on Ukraine. The main military hospital is supported by the David Nott Foundation, a UK charity that has trained more than 1,000 Ukrainian surgeons, anaesthetists and other healthcare workers. The leaders of Luxembourg, Moldova and Estonia as well as António Costa, the European Council president, are also in Kyiv for the talks on Ukraine’s Independence Day, amid Russia’s latest escalation.

Derbyshire, UK Burnt ground at Tintwistle Moor in Glossop. One of England’s largest wildfires in recent years began on 24 June and burned an estimated 606 hectares (1,497 acres) of moorland and woodland. The fire, which was declared a major incident on 13 July, burned for more than six weeks before being brought under control. With 71% of England in drought, high-risk areas such as moorland across the Peak District are in urgent need of rain to prevent further wildfires.
Huelva, Spain Scorched vegetation in the Sierra de Berrocal. The village of Berrocal has been devastated by a fire that was extinguished after burning through 33,000 hectares in 15 days.

Bureij, Gaza Displaced Palestinians fetch water from a cistern at a shelter camp. Gaza remains gripped by daily violence, with the Israeli military and Hamas accusing each other of violating the truce in effect since 10 October. The war flattened swathes of the territory, displaced most of the population at least once, and left hundreds of thousands of people living in tents and temporary shelters.
Cheshire, UK A drone view shows a dog walker casting a shadow as he walks around the Heath Park Lake which is almost dry after water shortages during the prolonged drought and a lack of maintenance.
London, UK A Humboldt penguin is weighed during the annual weigh-in at ZSL London zoo, where every mammal, bird, reptile, fish and invertebrate across the zoo is weighed and measured.

Beijing, China Staff carry a stretcher to move a humanoid robot that fell and could not finish a 400-metre obstacle race during the second World Humanoid Robot Games at the National Speed Skating Oval.

Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia Yasmine Fouad, the executive secretary of the UNCCD; Amina J Mohammed, deputy secretary-general of the UN; and Battsetseg Batmunkh, Mongolia’s minister for foreign affairs and president of the Cop17, speak to the media.
Hockenheim, Germany An aerial image of a corn maze forming the word Glücksgefühle (feelings of happiness).

Srinagar, Indian Kashmir Leaders and activists of the Jammu and Kashmir People’s Democratic party (PDP) shout slogans as Indian police try to stop them during a protest at the party headquarters. The protest came after the Jammu and Kashmir Electricity Regulatory Commission approved revised power tariffs, with the increase set to take effect on 1 September, amid concerns over rising household costs and the financial challenges facing the region’s power distribution utilities.
Washington DC, US Donald Trump waves a green flag to start the race, with Melania Trump at his side, at the Freedom 250 Grand Prix.
